summary.en: This starter - a motion portfolio for GitHub Pages by ITwerf.
summary.nl: Deze starter - een motion portfolio voor GitHub Pages van ITwerf.

description.en: Replace this card with your own projects. Devfolio is the framework you are looking at: static HTML/CSS/JS, dark mode, EN/NL, blog and downloads.
description.nl: Vervang deze kaart door je eigen projecten. Devfolio is het framework dat je nu ziet: statische HTML/CSS/JS, dark mode, EN/NL, blog en downloads.

summary.en: Demo: recolour the site via config/site.json theme tokens.
summary.nl: Demo: herkleur de site via theme-tokens in config/site.json.

description.en: Change theme.accent and theme.accentSoft in config/site.json. For layout colours, edit CSS variables in assets/css/site.css. Full steps are in the blog post "Customise the Devfolio theme".
description.nl: Pas theme.accent en theme.accentSoft aan in config/site.json. Voor layoutkleuren: CSS-variabelen in assets/css/site.css. Volledige stappen staan in de blogpost "Customise the Devfolio theme".

summary.en: Demo: enable/disable downloads and manage version zips.
summary.nl: Demo: downloads aan/uit en versie-zips beheren.

description.en: Toggle features.downloads in config/site.json. Add or remove rows in content/versions.json and matching files in releases/. Details in "Manage Devfolio downloads".
description.nl: Schakel features.downloads in config/site.json. Voeg rijen toe of weg in content/versions.json en bijbehorende bestanden in releases/. Details in "Manage Devfolio downloads".
